{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Garrison''' was one of the modules of the [[Maw Installation]]. It housed the security personnel and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] assigned to the Maw. It was also home to the base's primary communications array, detention center, and backup computer core.
